title: Networking
learning_outcomes: Explain reciprocal networks in the context of networking.
Compare and distinguish low-pressure requests in the context of networking.
Apply consent-based introductions in the context of networking.
Evaluate and justify decisions about follow-up in the context of networking.

lessons.title: Reciprocal networks
lessons.outcome: Explain reciprocal networks in the context of networking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reciprocal networks; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to ethical networking plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reciprocal networks from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reciprocal networks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Low-pressure requests
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish low-pressure requests in the context of networking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving low-pressure requests; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to ethical networking plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain low-pressure requests from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of low-pressure requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Consent-based introductions
lessons.outcome: Apply consent-based introductions in the context of networking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving consent-based introductions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to ethical networking plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain consent-based introductions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of consent-based introductions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Follow-up
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about follow-up in the context of networking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving follow-up; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to ethical networking plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain follow-up from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of follow-up; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of reciprocal networks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of low-pressure requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of consent-based introductions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of follow-up; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
